rv.q: On every level and in every sense The Motion is a truly joyful work that holds unending little gifts to experience as it twists and warps and melds its reality spectacularly.

cn.t: Critics praise Christopher Chen's thought-provoking play as a magnificent and remarkable exploration of AI, humanity, and ethics. The intelligent script and Arena Stage's in-the-round staging create a powerful, debate-driven theatrical experience.
